args.message: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money to implement banker's rounding per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which broke the nightly build since `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212.

## Change
Switch the rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
CI run ci-0001 passed on commit 08d3cd5986, including the banker's rounding tests (e.g. 2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66).

transcript.reasoning_content: Let me look at the files first.

Fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Note 2.675 → 2.68? With ROUND_HALF_EVEN quantize: 2.675 has exact Decimal 2.675, half is between 2.67 and 2.68 — the digit before is 7 (odd), so half-even rounds to 2.68. And 2.665 → 2.66 (6 even). Correct.
